title: Illegal Dumping Urgent
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report abandoned/illegally dumped drums or containers or leaves, grass clippings, yard and garden debris, and/or brush that has been deliberately dumped/blown into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report abandoned/illegally dumped drums or containers or leaves, grass clippings, yard and garden debris, and/or brush that has been deliberately dumped/blown into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. Please call 311 for more information.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 to report dumped material in a street, drainage area, or waterway.
